steps.en: Deploy the control plane and configure the GitHub App and sandbox credentials
steps.zh: 部署控制面，配置 GitHub App 和沙箱凭据

steps.en: Create a team, grant repositories and add model credentials
steps.zh: 创建团队，授予仓库并添加模型凭据

steps.en: Select the team and repository, then send a coding task in the web UI
steps.zh: 选择团队和仓库，在网页发送编程任务

steps.en: Start the sandbox, check out repositories and dispatch the prompt
steps.zh: 启动沙箱、检出仓库并派发提示词

steps.en: Stream the agent's progress to the shared session
steps.zh: 向共享会话推送助手的工作进度

value.en: Coding work continues in a shared cloud session after the requester leaves
value.zh: 请求人离线后，编程工作仍在共享云会话继续
